results.title: Onion, chicken prices make home-cooked meals costlier in July: Report
results.description: Vegetarian thali costs rose four percent year-on-year in July. Non-vegetarian thali prices increased nine percent due to higher chicken costs. Onion and vegetable oil prices also contributed significantly to these increases. Potato and tomato prices fell, partially offsetting the overall rise. Month-on-month, vegetarian thali costs saw a two percent jump.

results.title: PayGlocal to raise Rs 36.4 crore from Beenext at Rs 1,140 crore valuation
results.description: The company’s shareholders on July 25 approved the issue of 5,074 pre-series C compulsorily convertible preference shares at Rs 71,693.02 apiece to the fund through a private placement. The transaction marks a 32% increase from the Rs 865 crore valuation in its previous round.

results.title: ‘Just bihar things’: Man with fractured leg gets cardboard support; social media reacts to viral video
results.description: A man with a fractured leg at a Bihar government hospital received only cardboard as support due to a lack of plaster. This incident, captured in a viral video, sparked outrage, with critics highlighting the poor state of healthcare in the region despite significant investments.
